answer: Unique enclave attestation stops bulk forgery by binding each identity to one unclonable physical chip. Each chip signs an attestation with a monotonic counter; a reused key is rejected, like a prism giving each beam a distinct spectrum. The marginal cost of the k-th fake is one more device at 120 credits, so 1,000 fakes cost 120,000 credits, growing linearly; a replayed counter is a replay failure. An honest agent buys one device once and reaches the summit on that attestation. Only hardware-proven identities collect the nectar of task payments, undiluted by clones.
